newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: South Korea's KEPCO tenders to buy 2 mln bbls LSWR.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's KEPCO tenders to buy 2 mln bbls LSWR.

text.p: The Korean Electric Power Corp has issued a tender to buy a total of two million barrels of low sulphur waxy residue (LSWR) for delivery in January and February, traders said on Thursday.
The tender seeks one 400,000-barrel cargo of 0.3 percent sulphur grade fuel oil for delivery to Inchon in each January and February.
It also sought a cargo of 600,000 barrels to be delivered to Ulsan or Pusan in each January and February.
The tender closes December 9 and is valid until December 14. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082).
